title: Laser energy in vs fusion energy out, Dec 2022 shot

source.name: NIF achieves fusion ignition
source.publisher: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory / National Ignition Facility

notes: On December 5, 2022, NIF delivered 2.05 megajoules of laser energy to a fuel capsule and measured 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy released, the first laboratory fusion reaction to produce more energy than was used to start it.
